sources.title: ERA2 - Spirit of Shanghai Extravaganza Tickets
sources.content:
ERA2 - Spirit of Shanghai runs from March 21 through May 31, 2026, at Shanghai Circus World (2266 Gonghexin Road, Jing'an District). The production has won multiple awards including the National Stage Art Masterpiece Project and Ministry of Culture Innovation Award.

Tickets range from ¥361 to ¥880, with discounts starting at 5% off. Both 60-minute and 100-minute versions are available at identical prices.

The show features six signature acts: aerial bar performances that have won international acrobatics awards; an innovative water-trapeze combination; trampoline and aerial ring stunts; a unique pigeon-and-trapeze sequence requiring five years of preparation; BMX and rollerblading acrobatics; and 3D multimedia immersive effects.

Costumes blend French Rococo styling with traditional Chinese elements. The original soundtrack combines Western instruments with traditional Chinese instruments like guzheng and erhu.

E-tickets with QR codes (scannable entry). Tickets issued daily 11:00-19:00. All attendees require individual tickets. No refunds or exchanges permitted.

sources.title: Shanghai Circus World: ERA Intersection of Time
sources.content:
The acclaimed acrobatics show in Shanghai by Shanghai Era Entertainment Ltd. is one of the star night performances that premiered in 2005. It's characterized as a unique blend of the traditional as well as the modern with deep connections to Chinese acrobatic heritage.

Venue: Shanghai Circus World (上海馬戲城). Performance: ERA - Intersection of Time. Daily Showtime: 7:30 PM. Location: 2266 Gonghexin Road, Zhabei District. Visitors can reach it via Shanghai Circus World Station on Metro Line 1.

This show is well suited for even those experienced with Chinese acrobatics while also engaging children through comedic elements. The production maintains fast pace and escalating excitement throughout, combining traditional stunts with innovative theatrical presentation.

sources.title: Shanghai Circus World: ERA Intersection of Time, Happy Circus
sources.content:
Shanghai Circus World covers an area of 22,500 square meters with an Acrobatics Field containing 1,638 seats. It has distinctive architecture with a splendid golden vault.

ERA Intersection of Time: A stunning acrobatic show combining traditional Chinese arts and modern technologies, with performers presenting Chinese acrobatics, martial arts and dance in harmony with music, sound, lighting, and special effects including a water screen.

Happy Circus: Excellent circus with animal acts, breathtaking acrobatics and humorous clowns, with highlights including ribbon dance, big wheel, speedy motorcycle, performing sea lions, equestrian feats, and comedy magic.

Location: Jing'an District. Access via Metro line 1 at Shanghai Circus World Stop. Tickets are popular and can be easily sold out during peak season; book in advance. Arrive 20 minutes before the show.

sources.title: Shanghai: Circus World ERA Theatre Acrobatics Ticket
sources.content:
ERA is a multimedia odyssey combining traditional Chinese acrobatic arts and modern technology. The main show ERA2—Spirit of Shanghai combines China's traditional acrobatics with modern stage technology, creating an immersive audio-visual experience.

Two versions are performed: a 60-minute version and a 100-minute version, priced the same. The Trembling Bar Act has won the prestigious Golden Clown Award (Oscar of Acrobatics), with performers executing flips on a narrow bar only about twenty centimeters wide.

A combination of pigeons and a female trapeze act, prepared for 5 years by Shanghai Acrobatic Troupe performers, with up to 7 pigeons dancing in the air alongside the actress.

Ticket prices range from 280 yuan to 880 yuan. You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

sources.title: 上海马戏城_百度百科
sources.content:
上海马戏城位于上海市静安区共和新路2266号，是中国马戏第一城。建于1999年，占地2.25公顷，是集文化、体育、娱乐功能为一体的综合演艺中心。

主体为杂技场，具有独特的金色穹顶造型。场内配有1638座观众席，设置了旋转舞台、复合升降舞台、镜框式舞台等设施。高空设有3圈马道，可进行立体化演出。

建筑面积共29659平方米，包括杂技场、排练楼、兽房、娱乐城等。投资总额2.7亿元，场内拥有先进的灯光设备和多声道环绕音响系统。

以上海杂技团为演出主体，展现海派杂技风格。曾推出《时空之旅》等多媒体梦幻剧以及《欢乐马戏》等常驻演出项目。

交通：地铁1号线上海马戏城站可直达；多条公交线路（46、95、210、253等）均可到达。售票时间为早9:00至晚19:30。

sources.title: 上海马戏城ERA时空之旅演出时间安排与订票攻略
sources.content:
《时空之旅2》演出向人们讲述发生在上海的美丽邂逅和浪漫的爱情故事，通过精彩的杂技表演、新科技以及前所未有的舞台元素、多元艺术的融合，结合上海的历史文化和现代风情。

整场演出分为梦幻之境、时空秀水、碧波轻舟、千古绝顶、时空之轮、天籁之音、时空之恋、时空飞车等八大看点。

周六为100分钟版本，其他日期为60分钟版本。春节期间每天演出2场，分别为14:00和19:30。

网上订票截止时间为演出当天14:00点，建议提前网上订票。一人一票，儿童全票。建议绿色出行（地铁1号线，上海马戏城站，3号出口），马戏城停车位紧张。

sources.title: Shanghai Circus World - Wikipedia
sources.content:
Shanghai Circus World is located in Jing'an District and is the most popular place to see acrobatic shows in Shanghai. The venue covers an area of 22,500 square meters with a distinctive golden vault architecture. The Acrobatics Field contains 1,638 seats.

The two most famous shows are ERA Intersection of Time and Happy Circus, which have regular performance schedules. ERA combines traditional Chinese acrobatic arts with modern multimedia technology. The venue is accessible via Metro Line 1 at Shanghai Circus World Station.
